question:
Figure 1 is an oblique photo of a machine part; figure 2 shows the same part photographed frontally. Each candidate below is a 3x3 homography given row-major as nine numbers; applying it to figure 1 is meant to rectify it into figure 2's frontal frame. At most one candidate does this correctly. Which one?
(A) [0.938669, -0.330594, -12.9077, -0.001485, 0.61086, -3.25214, -0.000102226, -0.00113499, 1]
(B) [0.487002, 0.411722, -140.617, -0.103456, 0.687314, 98.369, -0.000937006, -0.000146364, 1]
(C) [1.67713, -0.327961, -204.752, 0.611716, 0.540183, -33.7212, 0.000687495, -0.00123076, 1]
(D) None of the candidates rectifies figure 1 correctly.

Answer with only the correct option letter.

</tool_call>

After applying candidate (C) to [img1], the resulting image [img5] shows the nut rotated and skewed in a way that is still not matching [img2]. The nut appears to be rotated further and the perspective is altered incorrectly.

Since none of the candidates (A, B, or C) correctly rectify [img1] into [img2], the correct answer is (D).
